mapper.sql: select po.id, po.order_no, po.student_name, po.student_phone, po.product_id, p.course_content product_content, po.product_amount, po.discount_amount, po.order_status, po.created_at, po.updated_at from prepay_order po inner join order_product p on p.id = po.product_id
mapper.insert: insert into prepay_order(order_no, student_name, student_phone, product_id, product_amount, discount_amount, order_status, created_at, updated_at) values(#{orderNo}, #{studentName}, #{studentPhone}, #{productId}, #{productAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{orderStatus}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update prepay_order set student_name = #{studentName}, student_phone = #{studentPhone}, product_id = #{productId}, product_amount = #{productAmount}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from order_product where id = #{productId}
select count(1) from prepay_order where order_no = #{orderNo}
select count(1) from order_payment where prepay_order_no = #{orderNo}
